CREATE TABLE public.support_agent (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE public.support_ticket (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, assignee_id INTEGER REFERENCES public.support_agent(id), status TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT support_ticket_status_check CHECK (status IN ('open', 'pending', 'resolved', 'closed')), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, first_response_at TIMESTAMPTZ)
CREATE TABLE public.feedback_cluster (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, priority INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE public.feedback_item (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, cluster_id INTEGER REFERENCES public.feedback_cluster(id), body TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)
